paragraphs: Rav Chama bar Ukva, in R. Zeira's time. Abaye, in his name: Kiddushin 72a. Aivu, Rav's grandson, in his name. R. Chelbo, in his name. R. Chama bar Gurya, in his name. R. Yonah said: R. Chama bar Akiva—Jerusalem Talmud, BeKhol MeArvin. In R. Yehoshua ben Levi's name: Jerusalem Yoma, chapter 2. He reported in R. Yosi bar Chanina’s name—Kiddushin 72a; at 55a, bar Akiva is a scribal error. Pesachim 52b; Sukkah 37b; Menachot 62a; Jerusalem Gittin, HaNizzakin, halakhah 3. R. Chama bar Ukva and the rabbis were sitting and having difficulty, etc. R. Levi passed; they said, “Here is the master of the teaching; let us ask him.” Levi said in R. Chama's name: Rabbah, end of Chayyei Sarah. Yedei Moshe writes that “Levi in R. Chama's name” does not mean this R. Chama bar Ukva, since R. Chama bar Ukva was himself having difficulty. He resolved in R. Shimon ben Lakish's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Kelal Gadol; Shevuot, chapter 7; Avodah Zarah, chapter 2.
